meta.name: add-signal
meta.description: Add Signal channel integration via signal-cli device-link. Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 接入 Signal 消息渠道，实现原生收发。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用里直接收发 Signal 消息。
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Signal channel for native messaging.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to send and receive Signal messages in your app.

howto.what: 把 Signal 变成助手的一个消息渠道:通过 signal-cli 设备关联,用你现有手机号码收发消息,支持私聊、群聊和 Note to Self,不注册新号码。
howto.when: 当你想让助手接入 Signal,或运行 /setup 添加渠道时触发;它会按步骤安装 signal-cli、复制适配器、扫码关联账号。

say.text: 帮我把 Signal 接入助手,用 signal-cli 扫码关联我的号码
say.note: 会安装 signal-cli 并生成可扫描的链接二维码

say.text: 把 Signal 群里的消息也接到助手,给每个群建一个会话
say.note: 新增的群各自获得独立会话

say.text: 新建一个 Signal 用户并授予 owner 权限
say.note: 该用户首次发言后可从数据库查到 UUID

howto.what_en: Connects Signal as a channel: the assistant sends and receives through signal-cli device-link, using the number on the phone that scans the link — no new number or bot API. Covers DMs, groups and Note to Self.
howto.when_en: Runs when you want to add Signal to the assistant, e.g. during /setup. It installs signal-cli, copies the adapter, then links your account by QR scan.

say_en.text: Add Signal to my assistant by linking my number with signal-cli
say_en.note: Installs signal-cli and prints a scannable link QR

say_en.text: Wire my Signal groups to the assistant, one session per group
say_en.note: Each new group gets its own session

say_en.text: Grant a new Signal user owner access
say_en.note: Find their UUID after their first message
